## Common questions about io.github.alexar76/attested-memory

Answered from the data above

### Who publishes io.github.alexar76/attested-memory?

The registry ties the namespace io.github.alexar76 to the GitHub account alexar76; only its owner can publish under it. Its linked repository, github.com/alexar76/attested-memory, belongs to the same GitHub account. These are facts from the registry and GitHub, not a rating.

### Is io.github.alexar76/attested-memory safe to install?

We do not rate servers as safe or unsafe. 5 of its 5 applicable record checks are met (facts from public records, each listed on this page). What the records show: Its source repository opens publicly. Its repository had a push in the last 90 days. 4 of its tools describe changing data (our AI model's reading of the descriptions). These are facts with their sources on this page, not a safety guarantee, and we did not run its tools.

### Does io.github.alexar76/attested-memory need an API key or sign-in?

It opened a session without any credential on 2026-10-23. The registry entry declares no required credential; no declaration is not a guarantee.

### Has io.github.alexar76/attested-memory been security tested?

Partly. 2 of the 14 checks that apply to it were exercised. We connected and read what the server declares, but did not call its tools: ProtocolProbe calls no server's tools for anything it publishes. This is our choice, not a block by the server. No security verdict is published before verification.

### What can io.github.alexar76/attested-memory do?

It lists 13 tools. In our AI model's reading of their descriptions (two runs had to agree, nobody checked it by hand), they include tools that read or search, run code or commands and move money. We did not call any tool, so this describes the text, not the behaviour.

### Can io.github.alexar76/attested-memory change or delete data?

4 of its tools say in their description that they create, edit, delete, send or run something (our AI model's reading). We did not call any tool, so we cannot say what actually happens.

### Does io.github.alexar76/attested-memory publish a security policy?

Yes: its repository has a public security policy (github.com/alexar76/attested-memory/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md). That is the publisher's statement, not permission for us to test the server, and we call none of its tools.

### Where is the source code of io.github.alexar76/attested-memory?

In github.com/alexar76/attested-memory, which opens publicly.
